fields.description: Displays the PeopleSoft invoice line details for Supply Chain cost actuals for SAS legacy Harris. Data excludes indirect projects.

fields.description: Metrics for Material Management.

fields.description: Metrics for Procurement.

fields.description: Metrics for Subcontracts.

fields.description: Pulls all requirements for Common CID (CAL1, CRS1, CMV1, CEW1) material and associated Demand CIDS.

fields.name: Contract Closeouts
fields.description: Used to identify contracts ready for closeout and all work items that need to be resolved to complete the closeout process. Includes metrics and goals for monthly review.

fields.description: All SAS EMRs in released status from PDM. Includes available PR and PO Numbers from Control, only captured if the PR has a comment with the exact EMR number. Refreshed daily.

fields.name: FMR Transactions

fields.name: Independent Demand Reporting
fields.description: Shows all independent demand based on MRP Requirements Table.

fields.description: Provides insight into Trakstar system, inventory aging, shelf-life expiration dates, and value of material in inventory.

fields.name: Kit Shortage Forecasting (COMR031)

fields.name: Material Cost - MUAC
fields.description: Gives the end user the ability to see system material cost.   Look-up one of an entire list at once.

fields.description: Replicates the MTLR014A and 45 reports from Cognos, includes the costed supply order report as well. Used to review planned orders, requisitions, and open orders (closed orders included but removed by default).

fields.name: Material Shelf Life Forecast (Trakstar Sites Only)

fields.name: MM Labor Data

fields.name: Planned Buy Orders

fields.description: The Program Health Dashboard offers metrics relevant to Program performance over the past 12 periods. Includes Contract Information, Financial Summary, and Earned Value metrics.

The Performance view provides earned value management analysis byCAMand Control Account. fields.name: Cobra Standardization
fields.description: Outlines standard data fields required in Cobra and tracks the status of adoption for each program.

fields.name: Program Staffing
fields.description: Program Staffing view to compare PeopleSoft actuals to Cobra ETC.

fields.description: The Risk & Opportunity Dashboards allow users to view R/O data at a portfolio level or at the individual project level.

fields.name: Program Review Template (PRT) Adoption
fields.description: Highlights eligibility and adoption of the Program Review Template by Sector for the past six periods.

fields.name: Risk Tracker Adoption
fields.description: Highlights eligibility and adoption of the Risk Tracker by Sector for the past six periods.

fields.name: SAS Program Tiering
fields.description: This dashboard displays SAS Program details scored and classified into Tiers (with other related attributes).

fields.name: SMART Adoption
fields.description: Segment and Sector view of schedule field quality issue burndown. Based on daily uploads of schedules to the SMART database.

fields.name: SMART Standards
fields.description: SMART Data Standards.

fields.name: Risk Tracker
fields.description: Risk Tracker is an MS Excel based Risk and Opportunity Management tool. Programs use the tool to identify and document risks and opportunities, associated mitigation plans, and facilitate monthly risk reviews.

fields.name: PMX BI SharePoint
fields.description: The PMX BI SharePoint site contains tool links and training resources for Program Management tools including PRT, PHD, Risk Tracker, CPR, and SMART.

fields.name: PLT Certification Dashboards
fields.description: Program Management Training and Certifications dashboards.

fields.name: SAS e3 Master Event Calendar
fields.description: The SAS e3 Master Event Calendar delivers a detailed and organized view of all e3 events, categorizing them by type, location and number of participants.

fields.name: e3 Analytics
fields.description: The e3 Skillset Proficiency Dashboard presents a consolidated view of e3 certification data across various sectors, and also offers a detailed summary by employee.

fields.name: SAS e3PPM
fields.description: The e3PPM serves as the central hub at CHQ for tracking project savings, aggregating e3 cost reductions across various stages of classification and implementation.

fields.name: Athena
fields.description: The Athena site serves as the central hub for the Operations performance indicators, including metrics such as labor utilization, production on-time delivery (OTD), and supplier OTD.

fields.name: SPM
fields.description: The SPM portal is designed to document quality improvement initiatives, offering a comprehensive summary view by segment, sector, and site, among other categorizations.

fields.name: EHS&S Analytics Report
fields.description: The EHS&S Analytics Report Dashboard provides a comprehensive overview of key Environmental, Health, Safety, and Sustainability indicators, including sector- and division-specific safety rates, as well as metrics such as 'Days Since Last Injury'.

fields.name: Submit an EHS Concern
fields.description: The 'Submit an EHS Concern' form is designed to collect critical details, such as the location and primary cause, enabling the EHS team to conduct an investigation of the reported concern.

fields.name: Submit an Injury Report
fields.description: The 'Submit an Injury Concern' form is designed to collect critical details, the nature of the injury or illness and the precise location of the incident for the EHS team to conduct an investigation of the reported injury.

fields.name: L3Harris Ergonomics
fields.description: The L3Harris Ergonomics page features a direct link to the ESCAN 2.0 assessment, enabling employees to report ergonomic concerns and establish tailored ergonomic actions.

fields.name: Fast Trax
fields.description: The Fast Trax page includes the request form and status page for the procurement and/or manufacturing of non-deliverable hardware only, per MOI-105  and S-607-035.

fields.name: SMT Schedule Dashboard - Malabar
fields.description: The Malabar SMT Production Dashboard is a comprehensive tool designed to provide real-time insights and analytics for the manufacturing process of Malabar SMT focusing on historic performance, workload allocation, and WIP status.

fields.name: SMT Schedule Dashboard - Palm Bay
fields.description: The Palm Bay SMT Production Dashboard is a comprehensive tool designed to provide real-time insights and analytics for the manufacturing process of Palm Bay SMT focusing on historic performance, workload allocation, and WIP status.

fields.name: SMT Schedule Dashboard - Clifton
fields.description: The Clifton SMT Production Dashboard is a comprehensive tool designed to provide real-time insights and analytics for the manufacturing process of Clifton SMT focusing on historic performance, workload allocation, and WIP status.

fields.name: SMT Stencil Management Tool
fields.description: The SMT Stencil Management Tool is a comprehensive PowerApps solution designed to streamline the management of SMT solder stencils. This app provides real-time tracking of all stencil locations allowing users to see current and past locations. The app also provides engineering the ability to order new stencils or dispose of obsolete stencils.

fields.name: Cable Cell Schedule Dashboard
fields.description: The Cable Cell Schedule is a comprehensive tool designed to provide real-time insights and analytics for the manufacturing process of cable cells.

fields.name: SMT Downtime Home Page
fields.description: The SMT Downtime is a tool for monitoring and analyzing downtime events within SMT production lines by providing a detailed breakdown of each categorized downtime incident and their YTD impact.

fields.name: Skill Matrix
